title: Private equity backers flag fresh concerns about sell-to-yourself deals
summary: Co-investors in buyout funds are raising fresh concerns about 'sell-to-yourself' deals. They are frustrated at being forced out when assets are sold into continuation vehicles.

title: Napoleon’s warning to Nvidia’s Jensen Huang
summary: An FT column draws on Napoleon to warn about Jensen Huang-style leadership. A flat hierarchy combined with micromanagement can dangerously concentrate power at the top.

title: Amazon’s AI resistance: workers ready for battle over data centres
summary: Amazon's plans for rapid data-center expansion are meeting resistance from both the public and its own employees. Workers are preparing to push back over the AI buildout.

title: Tech suppliers raise AI server prices up to 45% months after deals are signed
summary: Dell, HPE, Lenovo and Supermicro are raising AI server prices by up to 45% months after deals were signed. The higher costs are hitting buyers including trading firms.

title: Bolsas: ¿adiós a la fiesta? ¿llegó la cruda?
summary: Anthropic, creadora de Claude, colocó acciones a 83 dólares en la mayor salida a bolsa de la historia, con una oferta de 93,500 millones de dólares brutos que superó a SpaceX. La acción abrió en 111.50 dólares pero perdió la mitad del brinco ese mismo día, y el viernes el Nasdaq cayó 5.3% y el S&P 500 entró en corrección.

title: Australia Spy Chief Warns of Data Center, AI Risks, Age Reports
summary: Australia's spy chief warned that data centers and AI risk exposing the country to foreign interference and malicious state actors. The comments came in an interview with The Age.

title: SEC investiga prácticas contables de Nvidia tras cambios en reportes de ventas, según medios
summary: La SEC abrió una investigación sobre las prácticas contables de Nvidia tras cambios en sus reportes de ventas, según The New York Times. La indagatoria está en etapa inicial y suma incertidumbre tras la dimisión de su CEO, Jensen Huang.

title: Crowdstrike’s Talks With Zscaler Show AI-Led Cyber Consolidation
summary: CrowdStrike's talks with Zscaler highlight a wave of multibillion-dollar cybersecurity takeovers. The biggest players are consolidating to defend against increasingly sophisticated AI-powered attacks.

title: California Nvidia Probe Covers Potential Criminal Law Violations
summary: California's probe into whether Nvidia illegally sold advanced chips to China and misled investors also covers potential criminal violations of state law. The move raises the stakes for the chipmaker.

title: Goldman Sachs, Apollo Price $32 Billion SpaceX Bonds to Fund AI Chip Purchases
summary: Goldman Sachs and Apollo priced $32 billion of SpaceX bonds to fund AI chip purchases. The deal follows more than a year of work on financing AI chips without wrecking corporate balance sheets.

title: Wall Street Confronts AI Reality Check
summary: Anthropic's record IPO failed to reverse deteriorating sentiment as investors grapple with Nvidia turmoil, AI spending concerns and systematic-fund selling. Goldman Sachs' Panic Index has reached 9 out of 10, with weak liquidity and a wave of potential new issuance adding pressure.

title: Anthropic IPO Fails to Calm AI Jitters
summary: Seaport's Jonathan Golub argues the AI-driven selloff looks overdone, since compute demand and semiconductor earnings expectations keep rising. The bigger question, he says, is whether markets can keep financing the hundreds of billions in AI infrastructure capital needs.

title: Wall Street Asks What Can Save AI Trade After Anthropic Wipeout
summary: Wall Street is searching for a catalyst to revive the AI trade after Anthropic's IPO wipeout. The market has been hit by back-to-back shocks: the ouster of Jensen Huang from Nvidia and the Democrats' decisive midterm victory.

title: Anthropic Makes Its Public Market Debut
summary: Anthropic's landmark IPO tested investor appetite for frontier AI, giving the company fresh capital for its enormous computing needs as OpenAI weighs its own path to public markets. The segment also examines turmoil at Nvidia after Jensen Huang's departure and its search for new leadership.

title: China Plans to Strengthen AI Token Standards in Computing Push
summary: China's National Data Administration will strengthen standards for measuring and billing AI tokens and for quality assessment. The move is part of Beijing's push to guide its growing AI computing industry.

title: Gasolina Magna se queda sin subsidio, Hacienda le cobrará 6.70 pesos de IEPS por litro
summary: La gasolina Magna se queda sin subsidio fiscal. Hacienda le cobrará una cuota de IEPS de 6.70 pesos por litro.

title: El peso mexicano pierde 3,5% en la semana y toca los MXN$19,19, su peor nivel desde junio de 2025
summary: El peso mexicano perdió 3.5% en la semana y tocó 19.19 por dólar, su peor nivel desde junio de 2025. La depreciación responde a las expectativas sobre las tasas de interés futuras de Banxico y la Reserva Federal.

title: Wall Street sufre ola de ventas: S&P 500 y Dow Jones entran en corrección y Nasdaq se desploma
summary: El S&P 500 cayó 3.7% y el Dow Jones también entró en corrección, mientras el Nasdaq perdió más de 5% y borró sus ganancias del año, arrastrados por Anthropic, Nvidia y dudas sobre la rentabilidad de la IA. Las monedas latinoamericanas retrocedieron y el MSCI All Country World hiló siete sesiones a la baja.

title: México oficializa control a inversiones extranjeras y abre incertidumbre por adquisiciones
summary: México oficializó un mecanismo de control sobre inversiones extranjeras. La medida abre incertidumbre sobre cómo se revisarán y aprobarán futuras adquisiciones en el país.

title: Globant amplía programa de recompra de acciones: la carta de Migoya a accionistas
summary: El negocio de IA de Globant duplicó en un trimestre su ritmo anualizado de facturación a 106.6 millones de dólares, y la empresa ampliará su recompra de acciones a 250 millones, la mayor de su historia. La facturación del tercer trimestre fue de 611.1 millones, ligeramente por debajo del consenso.

title: Comienzan las ofertas para comprar Axtel y su controladora
summary: Comenzó el proceso de ofertas para comprar Axtel y su empresa controladora. Es una operación de M&A corporativo en México a seguir.

title: Hotel Tepoztlán / Taller Carlos Marín + Pasquinel Studio
summary: Between Tepoztlán and Amatlán in Morelos, Taller Carlos Marín and Pasquinel Studio designed a hotel master plan of four buildings that integrates the topography and views of the Tepozteco. The abandoned site's existing vegetation and trees shaped the project from the start.

title: ¿En quién confiamos cuando confiamos en una IA?
summary: Expansión analiza en qué se basa la confianza que depositamos en los sistemas de inteligencia artificial. El texto plantea quién está realmente detrás cuando confiamos en una IA.

title: Hotel Casa Zamná Tulum / Studio Arquitectos
summary: Casa Zamná is a boutique hotel by StudioArqs on a 5,160 m² beachfront plot in Tulum facing the Caribbean. The design fuses contemporary architecture with traditional regional elements and local culture.
